alt: Simple idea of a GAN: many real face images go into a GAN that learns patterns, and it generates a new face image. Generative means creating new data that looks similar to the data it learned from.
author: Deep Learning faculty

alt: The competition: the generator tries to fool the discriminator by disguising fake as real, the discriminator tries to detect the fake. Both improve over time and the competition helps the generator create more realistic data.
author: Deep Learning faculty

alt: Basic GAN architecture: random noise goes into the generator, which creates a fake image. The discriminator receives the fake image and a real image and answers real or fake.
author: Deep Learning faculty

alt: The discriminator receives images from two sources, real images and fake images from the generator, and outputs real or fake.
author: Deep Learning faculty

alt: Generator: input is random noise or a latent vector, output is a generated image, goal is to make the image realistic enough to fool the discriminator, like an artist trying to create a realistic painting.
author: Deep Learning faculty

alt: Discriminator: input is a real image from the dataset or a generated image from the generator, output is real or fake, goal is to correctly distinguish real images from generated images, like an art critic checking whether a painting is genuine.
author: Deep Learning faculty

alt: GAN training loop: random noise goes to the generator, which makes a fake image; the discriminator sees the fake and a real image and says real or fake; the loss is calculated, backpropagation runs, the parameters of both G and D are updated and the loop repeats.
author: Deep Learning faculty

alt: After training the generator alone is used: a new random noise goes into the trained generator and it creates a new image on its own.
author: Deep Learning faculty

alt: Training instability: the generator and discriminator learn at the same time with opposite goals. If the discriminator is too strong the generator is very poor; if the generator is too strong the discriminator struggles. Both must improve in a balanced way.
author: Deep Learning faculty

alt: Mode collapse: instead of many different faces (face 1 to face 5) the generator keeps producing the same face A, because producing only one or a few types of samples is enough to fool the discriminator.
author: Deep Learning faculty

alt: GAN applications 1 and 2: image generation (new human faces, objects, animals, scenery) and DeepFake (face swapping, face synthesis, manipulating facial expressions).
author: Deep Learning faculty

alt: GAN application 3, image-to-image translation: convert one type of image into another, for example sketch to realistic image, day to night, summer to winter.
author: Deep Learning faculty

alt: GAN application 4, image super-resolution: convert a low-resolution image (blurry or pixelated) into a higher-resolution one.
author: Deep Learning faculty

alt: GAN application 5, image restoration: remove noise, restore damaged or old images, and fill missing portions (inpainting).
author: Deep Learning faculty

alt: GAN application 6, data augmentation or synthetic data: generate additional training samples when real data is limited, for example more cat images from a few real ones.
author: Deep Learning faculty

alt: GAN applications 7 and 8: video generation or manipulation (generate or modify video frames, face and expression manipulation) and art and creative content (artistic images, new styles and designs).
author: Deep Learning faculty

alt: Image-to-image translation, discriminator step: it receives the real target-domain image and the generated image and asks whether the generated image looks like a real image from the target domain.
author: Deep Learning faculty

alt: Final result of image-to-image translation: a sketch of a house goes into the GAN and a realistic-looking house image comes out.
author: Deep Learning faculty

alt: Synthetic data final result: 500 real images plus synthetic images from the generator together form a larger training dataset.
author: Deep Learning faculty

alt: The pattern to remember: during training real data and fake data go to the discriminator, the loss gives a learning signal, parameters are updated and the loop repeats; after training only the trained generator is used with new random noise to produce the final output.
author: Deep Learning faculty
